entries.clue: Half-light after sunset, when hens take themselves off to roost
Fence of pointed logs thrown round a hut, held by the loyal party under fire
Running record in strokes of five, four upright and one struck across
Level finish, both players stuck on exactly the same score
Open your mouth wide despite yourself, and everyone nearby follows suit
Blunt, dutiful skipper of the Hispaniola, wary of the hands he was given
A parent reads one aloud in silly voices to settle a child for the night
Four-colour race to get all your pieces home before the others do
Turning on the side you swore to serve, quietly and from the inside
Soft filled bedcover that did away with the sheet-and-blanket routine
Blind pirate whose tapping stick leads him into the path of a charging horse
Sheltered nick in a coastline where a boat can slip ashore unseen
The demand that follows a thrashing: one more, best of three
Rasp and rumble in your sleep until a partner decamps to the spare room
